title: When to Use Secondary Colors
slide_intent: Teach where supporting colors can separate information inside dense research material. Color should help a reader identify groups or values.
strategic_value: CSAIL can give posters, slides and event schedules useful accents while leaving the main logo in its established colors.
demonstration: A research-poster excerpt sits beside a bar-chart slide and an event schedule. Supporting hues carry different quantities and schedule blocks across the three examples.
practical_value: Choose a secondary hue for a chart series, callout or schedule block. Keep ordinary body copy in a legible text color.

content_islands.name: Usage guidance
